audit_status.source_base: Hebrew Exodus / Shemot priestly garment instruction text tradition, draft aligned to public-domain comparison layer later
audit_status.review_note: First-pass draft reviewed for Aaron/sons, holy garments, ephod, stones of remembrance, breastpiece of judgment, Urim/Thummim, robe, plate, tunic, and dignity/beauty.

verses.restored: Bring near to you Aaron your brother and his sons with him from among children of Israel, to serve as priest to me: Aaron, Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar, sons of Aaron.

familiar.text: And take thou unto thee Aaron thy brother, and his sons with him, from among the children of Israel, that he may minister unto me in the priest’s office, even Aaron, Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar, Aaron’s sons.

verses.restored: You shall make holy garments for Aaron your brother, for glory and for beauty.

familiar.text: And thou shalt make holy garments for Aaron thy brother for glory and for beauty.

verses.restored: Speak to all wise of heart, whom I have filled with spirit of wisdom, and they shall make garments of Aaron to sanctify him, to serve as priest to me.

familiar.text: And thou shalt speak unto all that are wise hearted, whom I have filled with the spirit of wisdom, that they may make Aaron’s garments to consecrate him, that he may minister unto me in the priest’s office.

verses.restored: These are garments they shall make: breastpiece, ephod, robe, tunic of checker-work, turban, and sash; they shall make holy garments for Aaron your brother and his sons, to serve as priests to me.

familiar.text: And these are the garments which they shall make; a breastplate, and an ephod, and a robe, and a broidered coat, a mitre, and a girdle: and they shall make holy garments for Aaron thy brother, and his sons, that he may minister unto me in the priest’s office.

verses.restored: They shall take gold, blue, purple, scarlet, and fine linen.

familiar.text: And they shall take gold, and blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine linen.

verses.restored: They shall make ephod of gold, blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twisted linen, work of skilled designer.

familiar.text: And they shall make the ephod of gold, of blue, and of purple, of scarlet, and fine twined linen, with cunning work.

verses.restored: It shall have two shoulder pieces joined to its two ends, and it shall be joined.

familiar.text: It shall have the two shoulderpieces thereof joined at the two edges thereof; and so it shall be joined together.

verses.restored: The skillfully woven band on it, which is upon it, shall be of same work, from it: gold, blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twisted linen.

familiar.text: And the curious girdle of the ephod, which is upon it, shall be of the same, according to the work thereof; even of gold, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen.

verses.restored: Take two onyx stones and engrave on them names of sons of Israel,

familiar.text: And thou shalt take two onyx stones, and grave on them the names of the children of Israel:

verses.restored: six of their names on one stone and names of remaining six on second stone, according to their births.

familiar.text: Six of their names on one stone, and the other six names of the rest on the other stone, according to their birth.

verses.restored: Work of stone engraver, engravings of signet, you shall engrave two stones with names of sons of Israel; set around in gold filigree you shall make them.

familiar.text: With the work of an engraver in stone, like the engravings of a signet, shalt thou engrave the two stones with the names of the children of Israel: thou shalt make them to be set in ouches of gold.

verses.restored: Put two stones upon shoulder pieces of ephod, stones of remembrance for sons of Israel; Aaron shall bear their names before YHWH upon his two shoulders for remembrance.

familiar.text: And thou shalt put the two stones upon the shoulders of the ephod for stones of memorial unto the children of Israel: and Aaron shall bear their names before the LORD upon his two shoulders for a memorial.

verses.restored: Make gold filigree settings,

familiar.text: And thou shalt make ouches of gold;

verses.restored: and two chains of pure gold, twisted like cords, work of cord; put corded chains upon settings.

familiar.text: And two chains of pure gold at the ends; of wreathen work shalt thou make them, and fasten the wreathen chains to the ouches.

verses.restored: Make breastpiece of judgment, work of skilled designer; like work of ephod you shall make it: gold, blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twisted linen.

familiar.text: And thou shalt make the breastplate of judgment with cunning work; after the work of the ephod thou shalt make it; of gold, of blue, and of purple, and of scarlet, and of fine twined linen, shalt thou make it.

verses.restored: Square it shall be, doubled, a span its length and a span its width.

familiar.text: Foursquare it shall be being doubled; a span shall be the length thereof, and a span shall be the breadth thereof.

verses.restored: Fill in it settings of stones, four rows of stones: row of carnelian, topaz, and emerald, first row;

familiar.text: And thou shalt set in it settings of stones, even four rows of stones: the first row shall be a sardius, a topaz, and a carbuncle: this shall be the first row.

verses.restored: second row: turquoise, sapphire, and diamond/clear stone;

familiar.text: And the second row shall be an emerald, a sapphire, and a diamond.

verses.restored: third row: jacinth, agate, and amethyst;

familiar.text: And the third row a ligure, an agate, and an amethyst.

verses.restored: fourth row: beryl, onyx, and jasper; set in gold filigree in their settings.

familiar.text: And the fourth row a beryl, and an onyx, and a jasper: they shall be set in gold in their inclosings.

verses.restored: The stones shall be according to names of sons of Israel, twelve according to their names, engravings of signet, each according to its name, for twelve tribes.

familiar.text: And the stones shall be with the names of the children of Israel, twelve, according to their names, like the engravings of a signet; every one with his name shall they be according to the twelve tribes.

verses.restored: Make on breastpiece chains of corded work, twisted cords of pure gold.

familiar.text: And thou shalt make upon the breastplate chains at the ends of wreathen work of pure gold.

verses.restored: Make on breastpiece two gold rings, and put two rings on two ends of breastpiece.

familiar.text: And thou shalt make upon the breastplate two rings of gold, and shalt put the two rings on the two ends of the breastplate.

verses.restored: Put two gold cords on two rings at ends of breastpiece.

familiar.text: And thou shalt put the two wreathen chains of gold in the two rings which are on the ends of the breastplate.

verses.restored: Two ends of two cords you shall put on two settings and put them on shoulder pieces of ephod toward its front.

familiar.text: And the other two ends of the two wreathen chains thou shalt fasten in the two ouches, and put them on the shoulderpieces of the ephod before it.

verses.restored: Make two gold rings and put them on two ends of breastpiece on its edge that is toward inner side of ephod.

familiar.text: And thou shalt make two rings of gold, and thou shalt put them upon the two ends of the breastplate in the border thereof, which is in the side of the ephod inward.

verses.restored: Make two gold rings and put them on two shoulder pieces of ephod below, toward its front, close to its joining, above woven band of ephod.

familiar.text: And two other rings of gold thou shalt make, and shalt put them on the two sides of the ephod underneath, toward the forepart thereof, over against the other coupling thereof, above the curious girdle of the ephod.

verses.restored: They shall bind breastpiece by its rings to rings of ephod with blue cord, so it is above woven band of ephod, and breastpiece not move from ephod.

familiar.text: And they shall bind the breastplate by the rings thereof unto the rings of the ephod with a lace of blue, that it may be above the curious girdle of the ephod, and that the breastplate be not loosed from the ephod.

verses.restored: Aaron shall bear names of sons of Israel in breastpiece of judgment upon his heart when he enters holy place, for remembrance before YHWH continually.

familiar.text: And Aaron shall bear the names of the children of Israel in the breastplate of judgment upon his heart, when he goeth in unto the holy place, for a memorial before the LORD continually.

verses.restored: Put into breastpiece of judgment the Urim and the Thummim, and they shall be upon Aaron's heart when he enters before YHWH; Aaron shall bear judgment of children of Israel upon his heart before YHWH continually.

familiar.text: And thou shalt put in the breastplate of judgment the Urim and the Thummim; and they shall be upon Aaron’s heart, when he goeth in before the LORD: and Aaron shall bear the judgment of the children of Israel upon his heart before the LORD continually.

verses.restored: Make robe of ephod all blue.

familiar.text: And thou shalt make the robe of the ephod all of blue.

verses.restored: Its opening for head shall be in its middle; a binding shall be around opening, work of weaver, like opening of coat of mail, so it does not tear.

familiar.text: And there shall be an hole in the top of it, in the midst thereof: it shall have a binding of woven work round about the hole of it, as it were the hole of an habergeon, that it be not rent.

verses.restored: On its hem make pomegranates of blue, purple, and scarlet around its hem, and bells of gold between them all around.

familiar.text: And beneath upon the hem of it thou shalt make pomegranates of blue, and of purple, and of scarlet, round about the hem thereof; and bells of gold between them round about:

verses.restored: Gold bell and pomegranate, gold bell and pomegranate, around hem of robe.

familiar.text: A golden bell and a pomegranate, a golden bell and a pomegranate, upon the hem of the robe round about.

verses.restored: It shall be upon Aaron to minister; its sound shall be heard when he enters holy place before YHWH and when he goes out, so he does not die.

familiar.text: And it shall be upon Aaron to minister: and his sound shall be heard when he goeth in unto the holy place before the LORD, and when he cometh out, that he die not.

verses.restored: Make plate of pure gold and engrave on it, engravings of signet: Holy to YHWH.

familiar.text: And thou shalt make a plate of pure gold, and grave upon it, like the engravings of a signet, HOLINESS TO THE LORD.

verses.restored: Put it on blue cord, and it shall be on turban; toward front of turban it shall be.

familiar.text: And thou shalt put it on a blue lace, that it may be upon the mitre; upon the forefront of the mitre it shall be.

verses.restored: It shall be upon Aaron's forehead, and Aaron shall bear iniquity of holy things that children of Israel sanctify for all their holy gifts; it shall be on his forehead continually, for acceptance for them before YHWH.

familiar.text: And it shall be upon Aaron’s forehead, that Aaron may bear the iniquity of the holy things, which the children of Israel shall hallow in all their holy gifts; and it shall be always upon his forehead, that they may be accepted before the LORD.

verses.restored: Weave tunic of fine linen, make turban of fine linen, and make sash, work of embroiderer.

familiar.text: And thou shalt embroider the coat of fine linen, and thou shalt make the mitre of fine linen, and thou shalt make the girdle of needlework.

verses.restored: For sons of Aaron make tunics, sashes, and caps; make them for glory and beauty.

familiar.text: And for Aaron’s sons thou shalt make coats, and thou shalt make for them girdles, and bonnets shalt thou make for them, for glory and for beauty.

verses.restored: Put them on Aaron your brother and his sons with him; anoint them, fill their hand, and sanctify them, and they shall serve as priests to me.

familiar.text: And thou shalt put them upon Aaron thy brother, and his sons with him; and shalt anoint them, and consecrate them, and sanctify them, that they may minister unto me in the priest’s office.

verses.restored: Make for them linen undergarments to cover naked flesh; from loins to thighs they shall be.

familiar.text: And thou shalt make them linen breeches to cover their nakedness; from the loins even unto the thighs they shall reach:

verses.restored: They shall be upon Aaron and his sons when they enter tent of meeting or approach altar to minister in holy place, so they do not bear iniquity and die. It is age-long statute for him and his seed after him.

familiar.text: And they shall be upon Aaron, and upon his sons, when they come in unto the tabernacle of the congregation, or when they come near unto the altar to minister in the holy place; that they bear not iniquity, and die: it shall be a statute for ever unto him and his seed after him.

translation_notes: Priestly garments are for kavod/glory and tipheret/beauty, not vanity.
Wise-hearted artisans are filled with spirit of wisdom; craft is Spirit-enabled work.
Names of Israel are borne on shoulders and heart: priestly role carries people in remembrance and judgment before YHWH.
Urim/Thummim should be preserved without overexplaining ancient divinatory function in first pass.
Undergarment instruction protects bodily dignity and ritual safety.
safety_note: Priestly hierarchy must not be used to justify domination. The garments symbolize representative burden-bearing, beauty, holiness, and accountable service before YHWH.
